title: Kiritani Haruka — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Haruka's birthday
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, it's time!
Starting the stream in five, four...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hey everyone, can you hear us?
The stream has started!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And today is...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka Kiritani's special birthday stream!
Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yay!>
<Happy birthday, Haruka!>
<Happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's a lot of comments coming in wishing you a happy birthday, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone!
Let's have a fun time today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This day only comes once a year, so we should all celebrate to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Roger dodger!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, I am very blessed today for this—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What's with the formal speech?
Also, don't forget you're part of the stream too, so save whatever that was for later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well then, shall we start with our segment?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds good! Shizuku, if you could please.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course! Allow me to announce the special segment we've prepared for today. It's called...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “Let's investigate Haruka! Gather info to find the perfect gift!”

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Hurray!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, Minori and I have each gone out and asked some of Haruka's close friends what gift she would like.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We then prepared a gift based on the information we received. The winner of this segment is determined by which gift Haruka picks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, we made sure that Haruka selected the gift without knowing who prepared what.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh! “Selected?!”
So that means the winner has already been confirmed...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's right!
And the answer is in this envelope!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be playing videos that show the info we received that led us to pick the gifts we did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we wanted Haruka to choose based on her first impression, so we made sure she won't be changing her answer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, if there's anything that you notice or feel when watching the videos then please let us know.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. I've been waiting to find out who picked what gift, so I'm very excited.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To everyone watching, see if you can predict which gift I picked as we go through the videos!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
First up is me, Minori Hanasato!
Take a look at this video!
A Certain Place on a Certain Day and Time

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Okay... It should be recording now...>
<Yup, it's recording. I'll take it from here!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Hi Haruka, and everyone watching Haruka's special birthday stream! I'm Minori Hanasato!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I've decided to ask Haruka's best friend since elementary school, A, about what Haruka would like as a gift!>

rows.Speaker: A
rows.Line: <Hello!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Also, A is someone super close to Haruka and has known her since before she became an idol!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Haruka's best friend?! That's amazing!>
<Minori hit the jackpot finding someone like that.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I would love to ask what Haruka was like back in elementary school, but let's get to business. What do you think Haruka would want as a gift?>

rows.Speaker: A
rows.Line:
<What would she want, huh...
Haruka really takes care of her stuff, which makes it all last for a long time. So she doesn't usually want a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Yeah, I see what you mean. She doesn't treat her stuff carelessly. Even her stationery is in impeccable condition!>

rows.Speaker: A
rows.Line: <Right? But, there is one thing that gets beaten and battered in no time, no matter how much she tries to take care of them.>

rows.Speaker: A
rows.Line: <And that is her running shoes!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Oh! Now that you mention it, I've seen her buy multiple of the same pair because they wear out so fast!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Mhmm, I see...
Thank you for your valuable insight, A!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Also, thank you for helping out with recording, K!>

rows.Speaker: K
rows.Line: <Hehe, it was my pleasure!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that was the video of my interview!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In conclusion! Based on the important info I got, I went with...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka's favorite running shoes plus a pack of cute and chic shoelaces!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You got her not only shoes, but shoelaces too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! The shoes will eventually get worn out, but the shoelaces can be used on other pairs too!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Ooh! She actually thought ahead.>
<I'm surprised she thought that far.>
<Nice! Not too overbearing either.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By the way, thanks to A and K's help, I was able to find these super cute and chic shoelaces with penguins on them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What? You even got them to help you find the gift? That's unfair!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I didn't ask them to!
They did it of their own volition, so I'm not guilty!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. Knowing An and Kohane, they probably would do that.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I guess it's already in the past.
Besides, I did something a little unconventional myself, so I'll let this one go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Unconventional?
A Certain Place on a Certain Day and Time

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hey everyone! Thanks for tuning in to the stream!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <One special delivery of love coming right up! It's the lovely fairy, Airi Momoi!>
<Wow! I get to see the Momoi pose in person!>

<Yay☆
Thank you, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <No, thank you for agreeing to help me, both of you.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Now let me introduce you to our viewers!
First we have Haruka's former classmate, S!>

rows.Speaker: S
rows.Line: <Hello!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And next we have E, who was on the Sports Festival Planning Committee with Haruka and S!>

rows.Speaker: E
rows.Line: <Hello and thanks for having me♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hehe. These two are not only Haruka's friends, but also my cute juniors!>

rows.Speaker: S
rows.Line: <Airi taught us how to bake chocolate cakes for Valentine's Day!>

rows.Speaker: E
rows.Line: <Hehehe. She showed us how to make cute stuff out of marzipan too☆>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Whaaat! Give me the deets! I need to know more!>
<Airi is really good around the kitchen.>
<What is this adorable convo? It's soothing my soul...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <With that being said, I also invited these two over since they're easy to talk to. Thank you again for agreeing to help me today.>

rows.Speaker: S & E
rows.Line: <Of course♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Now, jumping right into it...
What gift do you think Haruka would want?>

rows.Speaker: S
rows.Line: <I got an idea! A body that's immune to sugar so that every day is cheat day!>

rows.Speaker: E
rows.Line: <Yeah! Even though Haruka loves sweets, she always tries hard to avoid them.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <You've got a point. A body that allows you to have cheat day every day would make anyone cry out of happiness.>

rows.Speaker: S
rows.Line: <But that doesn't seem possible, does it?>

rows.Speaker: E
rows.Line: <Then what about a coupon to a place where she can eat lots of yummy food on a day she's allowed to?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That's an idea. Since it would be her cheat day, I would want her to enjoy delicious food as much as possible.>

rows.Speaker: All Three
rows.Line: <Hmmm...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So the three of us thought long and hard as we weighed out different options!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm loving their junior-senior bond.>
<That heartwarming scene was so adorable.>
<I feel all fuzzy inside...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What gift did you end up choosing, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I picked...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A ticket to an all-you-can-eat sweets buffet supervised by a three-star hotel, and it comes with a special chef!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
C-Comes with a special chef?!
Is that what you meant by unconventional?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. The thing is, the place I got a ticket for also allows you to make some simple sweets using the ingredients they provide.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But that takes up time you could use for eating, right?
So I made sure that Haruka can just focus on enjoying the food.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. So that's why...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, by the way, the chef will be me!
Service can also count as a gift, so I'm in the clear too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe, right.
This is also a special service that only you can do, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I don't have any doubts about your dessert-making skills.
I'm sure you already have a few recipes up your sleeve.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, I can't say you're wrong.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Last up is Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I was also able to get some very reliable people to help me think of a great gift, so please have a look.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, let's play the video!
